responsibility: Implements GCC’s main AVX intrinsic header, defining the core 256-bit vector types, compare predicate constants, casts, constructors, data movement helpers, and arithmetic/logical/vector builtins for the AVX ISA. This is the foundational 256-bit SIMD API layer for x86: it conditionally enables avx, introduces __m256/__m256i/__m256d and related internal vector aliases, and maps the published intrinsic names to GCC vector operations and target builtins.
